profile.professional_summary: Early-career machine-learning engineer with an M.Sc. in Computational Science and hands-on experience in NLP, deep learning, scientific computing, API development, model evaluation, and reproducible ML workflows.

evidence: Used Python across machine-learning, scientific-computing, and API projects.
Used PyTorch for transformer fine-tuning and neural-network research.
Built a typed API for an explainable CV-based job-search and recommendation system.
Used Docker in ML engineering workflows and project infrastructure.

highlights: Fine-tuned a Turkish transformer model for named-entity recognition.
Improved span-level micro-F1 from 0.44 to 0.75 through preprocessing and model fine-tuning.
Worked with annotation workflows, AWS compute, Docker, and Git.
Applied PCA and K-means clustering for tissue-region analysis.
Produced reproducible Python analysis and visualization workflows.

projects.name: CareerMatch Agent
projects.summary: Explainable agentic AI job-search system with CV extraction, structured profile generation, job-provider integration, deterministic filtering, semantic ranking, grounded LLM reports, and LangGraph orchestration.
highlights: Implemented provider-independent job retrieval and deterministic hard filters.
Added multilingual semantic ranking and evidence-grounded job reports.
Orchestrated the matching pipeline with a bounded LangGraph workflow.

projects.name: Predictive Maintenance ML
projects.summary: End-to-end predictive-maintenance machine-learning project with data cleaning, feature engineering, model comparison, evaluation, and CLI/notebook workflows.
highlights: Built a reproducible supervised-learning workflow and compared predictive models.

details: Graduate work included machine learning, scientific computing, and neural-network research.
Physics background with numerical and computational problem solving.
